Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About De-Tan SPF 50+ Body Sunscreen Lotion Why do I need two different sunscreens for face and body? Face skin is thinner, acne-prone, and spends more time under makeup — it needs a lightweight, non-comedogenic formula. Body skin is thicker and more exposed -it needs a hydrating, tan-correcting formula with a stronger moisture base. Using one for both leaves gaps in protection or causes breakouts. Is SPF 50+ PA++++ enough for daily use? Yes. SPF 50+ blocks around 98% of UVB rays, and PA++++ is the highest UVA protection rating available - ideal for Indian sun exposure. Reapply every 2–3 hours if you're outdoors. How long before I see the tan reduce? Tan correction is gradual. With daily use and consistent reapplication, most users notice more even skin tone within a few weeks. Results vary with skin type and sun exposure. Will it leave a white cast? No. Both formulas are designed for Indian skin tones. The face sunscreen has an aqua-gel texture that disappears in 3 seconds; the body lotion absorbs clean with no ghostly film. Is the face sunscreen safe for acne-prone skin? Yes- it contains ACZERO, a Korean anti-acne technology that is non-comedogenic and anti-inflammatory, tested safe even on active-acne skin. Is it water and sweat resistant? The face sunscreen is clinically proven water and sweat resistant up to 80 minutes. The body lotion is non-transferring once absorbed. Reapply after swimming or heavy sweating. Can I wear the face sunscreen under makeup? Yes. Apply after moisturiser, wait 60 seconds, then proceed with your makeup. It won't pill or ball up. Is this duo suitable for men? Yes. Both formulas are gender-neutral and built around skin type and skin zone, not gender.
